status: Phase 8 implementation contract; training hyperparameter grid is deferred to the engineering pilot.

graph_construction.connectivity: Fisher-z transformed Pearson ROI time-series association
graph_construction.node_features: Each node receives its full 116-value Fisher-z connectivity row.
graph_construction.edges: Binary, undirected strongest positive off-diagonal associations only.
graph_construction.tie_break: Canonical strict-upper-triangle order after stable descending score sort.
graph_construction.zero_density: No propagation edges; all inter-node aggregation/diffusion is absent.

preprocessing.feature_scaling: Feature-wise mean/std fitted only on graphs in the relevant training partition, over participant and node dimensions.

shared_backbone.note: Optimizer, learning-rate grid, batch size, epochs, patience, seeds, and retry policy are frozen only after the Phase 9 engineering pilot.

operators.identity: Pointwise shared update only; no inter-node propagation.
operators.gcn: Kipf-Welling symmetric normalized adjacency with one self-loop.
operators.trivial_bundle: Exact dense graph heat diffusion with fixed identity O(2) transports.

learned_bunn.map_source: Feature-conditioned direct O(2) parameterization: half rotations and half reflections.
learned_bunn.diffusion: Exact dense exp(-tL) graph heat kernel with pilot t=1.0.
learned_bunn.implementation_note: The flat-bundle heat-diffusion/update ordering follows Bamberger et al. (ICLR 2025); capacity from learned transport is reported rather than hidden.

diagnostics.common_frame: Apply the learned local-to-global O_v before comparing node representations.
metrics: mean invariant edge transport distance ||x_u - O_u^T O_v x_v||^2

results_embargo: No neural held-out-site metric may be used before the Phase 9 pilot and final-run contract are frozen.
